mapping.author: claude-mapper-wave3
mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Stromkirk Bloodthief
# "At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on
# target Vampire you control."  `parse` gives this exact tree for "... on target creature you
# control." (frame B13-end-step+if+B5b-put-counter); the tribal noun adds SUBTYPE_EQ 'Vampire'
# (MAPPER_GUIDE: tribal nouns are SUBTYPE_EQ plus TYPE_EQ 'Creature').
end_step_counter = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(
        phase=Phase.END_TURN,
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(
        pred=FAtomPred.EVENT_THIS_TURN,
        count=QConst(value=1),
        event=LifeLostEvent(
            actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),
        ),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Vampire'),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [end_step_counter, *compiled]

clauses.clause: At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target Vampire you control.

mapping.notes: parse gives this exact tree for '... put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.' (B13-end-step+if+B5b-put-counter); the tribal noun adds SUBTYPE_EQ Vampire (MAPPER_GUIDE tribal-noun shape). Self-check packs (scratch): counter after an opponent loses life, none without.
